Application Data.NAME: Artisan Creations Studio
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Jane Doe, Studio Manager, Artisan Creations Studio, 123 Art Lane, Craftsville, CA 90210-1234, (555) 123-4567, jane.doe@artisancreations.com
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Artisan Creations Studio specializes in creating and teaching various art forms including painting, pottery, and mixed media crafts. Our studio provides a safe and engaging environment for artists of all skill levels, offering classes and workshops led by experienced instructors. We ensure compliance with safety standards, particularly in areas related to material use and equipment. All instructors maintain oversight and are required to submit proof of insurance to guarantee sufficient coverage during classes. We are committed to sustainable practices and only utilize native plant materials in our artistic creations to avoid environmental and regulatory risks.

evidencing adequate coverage. Studios must maintain oversight and ensure subcontractors
comply with safety and operational standards.
